observed_value: Two rows stored as PRIVATE_CREDIT/DIRECT_LENDING with blank interest_rate and no basis_spread
anchor_value: Raw SOI places both rows in the Other Equity section with blank Reference Rate and Spread and blank Interest Rate cells

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Other Equity / Metropolis Technologies, Inc. / blank Reference Rate and Spread / blank Interest Rate / 5/16/2034 / $20 fair value
Other Equity / Mews Systems B.V. / blank Reference Rate and Spread / blank Interest Rate / 9/14/2029 / $1,227 fair value

findings.detail: Metropolis Technologies, Inc. Other Equity was stored as PRIVATE_CREDIT/DIRECT_LENDING, causing X02 to expect debt rate fields that are structurally blank for this equity row.
Mews Systems B.V. Other Equity was stored as PRIVATE_CREDIT/DIRECT_LENDING, causing X02 to expect debt rate fields that are structurally blank for this equity row.

rationale: X02 is a row-level missing-rate flag. The raw schedule shows both flagged holdings are not debt rows with missing coupon data; they sit under the Other Equity heading, with blank reference-rate and interest-rate columns. The data error is that these equity rows were classified as PRIVATE_CREDIT/DIRECT_LENDING, which made the missing-rate validation apply to rows where rate fields are not applicable.
